programme.title: The Beast With A Million Eyes
programme.desc: An unspeakable horror! Extraterrestrial terror is on the hunt for human flesh in this horrifying tale of invasion! This is a 1950s creature-feature with some serious sociological bite! Paul Birch, Lorna Thayer, and Richard Sargent star!

programme.title: Day The World Ended
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic world after an atomic war, seven disparate people find themselves in a protected valley in the home of a survivalist and his beautiful daughter.

programme.title: Invaders From Mars
programme.desc: In the early 1950s, Cold War tensions and the burgeoning space race created a heady mix of paranoia and unbridled creativity as filmmakers speculated as to the marvels - and horrors - that lay beyond the stars.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam, and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death.”

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
programme.desc: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to have revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

programme.title: Smile
programme.desc: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic patient incident, Dr. Rose Cotter (Sosie Bacon) starts experiencing terrifying visions. As the lines between reality and nightmares blur, Rose must confront her troubling past to escape her chilling new reality.

programme.title: A Quiet Place Part II
programme.desc: Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

programme.title: Hollow Man
programme.desc: Kevin Bacon and Elisabeth Shue play former lovers who, along with a team of other scientists like themselves, discover the secret of invisibility.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy and America's funniest family are back for seconds in the comedy sequel about what happens when Sherman Klump's nutty alter ego, Buddy Love, starts throwing his weight around!

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Big Happy Family
programme.desc: When Shirley receives distressing news about her health, it’s up to her Aunt Madea to gather the clan and make things right the only way she knows how: with tough love and laughter.

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: Kung Fu Killer (2014)
programme.desc: Released from prison, a kung-fu expert (Donnie Yen) tries to help the police find a vicious serial killer (Wang Baoqiang) who targets martial-arts masters.

programme.title: Chasing the Dragon
programme.desc: Donnie Yen stars as infamous real-life drug kingpin Crippled Ho, who ruthlessly carved out his empire in 1960's Hong Kong.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: Shan (Donnie Yen) is a hardline cop with a long history of success, but his past comes back to haunt him when a sting is attacked by a group led by his former protégé (Nicholas Tse), a man set on destroying everyone who ever wronged him.

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
programme.desc: There’s a mad bomber on board, the first lunar shuttle is about to self-destruct, the engines are not working, and worst of all, the flight crew discovers they are completely out of coffee!

programme.title: Bruce Almighty
programme.desc: When a frustrated, downtrodden reporter curses the sky, God appears, endows him with divine powers, and challenges him to run the world for a week.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Elvis And Annabelle
programme.desc: Anabelle is a small town beauty on the road to being crowned the Miss Texas Rose title, when she tragically dies and on stage due to an eating disorder.

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.

programme.title: Sense and Sensibility
programme.desc: Emma Thompson stars in the captivating romance based on Jane Austen's classic novel of two sisters' search for love in strict Victorian society.

programme.title: Identity
programme.desc: What if every choice we ever made was already made for us? What if there really were no coincidences in life and our destinies were already predetermined? Ten strangers with secrets are brought together in a savage rainstorm. Rated: R

programme.title: Secret Window
programme.desc: Academy Award® nominee Johnny Depp (2003 Best Actor, Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl) gives his most riveting performance in this action/suspense thriller featuring a top-notch cast.

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Johnny Depp is Ichabod Crane, an investigator determined to stop the murderous Headless Horseman.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st Airborne Division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Truman doesn’t realize that his quaint hometown is a giant studio set run by a visionary producer/director/creator (Ed Harris), that folks living and working there are Hollywood actors, and that even his incessantly bubbly wife is a contract player.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Africa's the place where Ace is on the case, setting out to rescue an animal he loathes - a bat! If you're ready to laugh like a pack of hyenas, if you want more fun than an industrial-sized barrel of monkeys, you'll know what to do. Heed the call.

programme.title: That Thing You Do!
programme.desc: Are you ready to rock n' roll? The Wonders are here to take you back to a simpler time when being famous was a bit more innocent.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After a seemingly innocent sexual encounter, 19-year-old Jay becomes trapped by a vicious curse - "it" is following her, and the only way to save herself is to put others in harm's way.

programme.title: April Fool's Day
programme.desc: When Muffy St. John invited her college friends up to her parents’ secluded island home for the time of their lives, she just forgot to tell them it might be the last time of their lives.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Cujo
programme.desc: While Donna and Vic Trenton struggle to save their rocky marriage, their son Tad befriends the loveable 200-lb St. Bernard who belongs to their mechanic.

programme.title: Who's Harry Crumb?
programme.desc: John Candy is bigger, better, and more bumbling than ever as a soft-headed private eye determined to crack a kidnapping case.

programme.title: Planes, Trains & Automobiles
programme.desc: Neal just wants to fly home to Chicago for Thanksgiving with his family. But all he gets is misery. Misery named Del Griffith, a loud-mouthed salesman who leads Neal on a wild goose chase.

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: High school senior, Ferris Bueller, decides to cut school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

programme.title: Popeye
programme.desc: The legendary, beloved anvil-armed sailor of the seven seas comes magically to life in this delightful musical, starring Robin Williams as Popeye, who meets all challenges with the unshakable philosophy, "I yam what I yam and that's all that I yam."

programme.title: Summer Rental
programme.desc: Comedy sensation John Candy plays the stressed-out air traffic controller whose much-needed family holiday yields one hysterical misadventure after another.

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: Armored
programme.desc: A crew of officers at an armored transport security firm embarks on the ultimate heist – against their own company. The seemingly foolproof plan proves useless when an unexpected witness interferes, and it quickly unravels.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: A Hollywood stunt performer (Ryan Gosling) who moonlights as a wheelman discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: In the course of one magical evening, Jonathan (John Cusack) and Sara (Kate Beckinsale) meet unexpectedly, but part ways, determining that fate will guide their future if they're meant to be together.

programme.title: Benny & Joon
programme.desc: Johnny Depp and Mary Stuart Masterson star in this quirky romantic Drama about two misfits who Comedye together as a result of an unusual poker game. Aidan Quinn and Julianne Moore co-star.

programme.title: Pretty In Pink
programme.desc: She’s a high school girl from the wrong side of town. He’s the wealthy heartthrob who asks her to the prom. But as fast as their romance builds, it’s threatened by the painful reality of peer pressure.

programme.title: High School High
programme.desc: From the creators of the Naked Gun series comes High School High. Richard C. Clark is an idealistic young teacher who leaves a position at a prestigious school headed by his own father to teach at Marion Barry High.

programme.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
programme.desc: Comedy sensation Mike Myers stars with Nancy Travis in this hatchet-driven romantic comedy about a wedlock-shy coffee house poet who finally meets the perfect woman. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
programme.desc: When the brilliant but unorthodox scientist Dr. Victor Frankenstein rejects the artificial man that he has created, the Creature escapes and later swears revenge.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: Cheech and Chong make their film debut in this riotous rock'n'roll comedy, bringing with them the same madness, lifestyles and sketches that sold over 10 million records in the early 1970s.

programme.title: The Longest Yard (1974)
programme.desc: In this rough-and tumble movie, actually filmed on-location at the Georgia State Prison, the cons are the heroes and the guards are the heavies.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic from spreading worldwide.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Street Fighter (1994)
programme.desc: Based on the popular video game, this adventure stars martial arts star Jean-Claude Van Damme as a commando leading an elite team of street fighters against the forces of an evil general.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: When flesh-eating zombies are on the hunt, it's up to slacker Shaun and his best pal to save their friends and family from becoming the next entrée.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Nicholas Angel is an unstoppable cop who, with the help of his bumbling partner, delivers some big-city justice in a small, quiet town.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: In this visionary film, Will and Jake Grimm dazzle small towns with their imaginative folklore and elaborate illusions, only to discover that many of the fantastic characters and thrilling situations from their beloved fairy tales are real.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: Molly Bloom runs the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested by the FBI. Her only ally is defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learns that there is much more to Molly than the tabloids lead people to believe.

programme.title: Divergent
programme.desc: In a future society, people are divided into factions based on their personalities. After a young woman (Shailene Woodley) learns she is a Divergent and will never fit into any one group, she uncovers a conspiracy to destroy all those like her.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
programme.desc: Fugitives Tris and Four search for allies and answers among the ruins of Chicago while arduously trying to evade Jeanine, leader of the Erudite.

programme.title: St. Vincent
programme.desc: Bill Murray and Melissa McCarthy star in this hilarious comedy about a war vet whose idea of after-school activities for his 12-year-old neighbor includes race tracks and strip clubs.

programme.title: The Impossible
programme.desc: Nominated for an Academy Award® (Best Actress, Naomi Watts), this gripping drama tells the incredible true story of one family’s survival in the face of impossible odds.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: Selma
programme.desc: From the Oscar-winning producers of 12 Years a Slave comes a powerful true story starring David Oyelewo and Oprah Winfrey. Facing violent opposition, Martin Luther King, Jr., led a historic march from Selma to Montgomery, changing the world forever.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: On the Come Up
programme.desc: The story 16-year-old Bri, who wants to be one of the greatest rappers of all time. Facing controversies and with an eviction notice staring down her family, Bri doesn't just want to make it, she has to.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Rocky V
programme.desc: Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

programme.title: Rocky Balboa
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born. But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: Advertising executive Marcus Graham is a quintessential bachelor. Graham is never without a new lady on his arm. Enter Jacqueline, his new boss, and Marcus is on the receiving end of his own patented behavior for the first time!

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: As the vampire Maximillian, the popular star is the most diabolical, dashing, and definitely undead dude in the ‘hood.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part II
programme.desc: Five years after the bloodbath at Camp Crystal, all that remains is the legend of Jason and his demented mother, who had murdered seven camp counselors. At a nearby summer camp, the new counselors are unconcerned about the warnings to stay away.

programme.title: Friday the 13th - Part III
programme.desc: Ignoring Camp Crystal Lake’s bloody legacy, one by one they fall victim to the maniacal Jason who stalks them at every turn...

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part - IV: The Final Chapter
programme.desc: After his revival in a hospital morgue, the hockey-masked murderer fixes his vengeful attention on the Jarvis family and a group of hitherto carefree teenagers.

programme.title: Invaders From Mars
programme.desc: In the early 1950s, Cold War tensions and the burgeoning space race created a heady mix of paranoia and unbridled creativity as filmmakers speculated as to the marvels - and horrors - that lay beyond the stars.

programme.title: The War of the Worlds (1953)
programme.desc: Gene Barry and Ann Robinson are among the humans intrigued when a meteor-like object crashes to Earth … but its occupants are definitely not friendly.

programme.title: It! The Terror From Beyond Space
programme.desc: The survivor of a space expedition claims his crew was killed by an alien creature. The rescue captain dismisses the explanation only to find that a creature has stowed away on the spacecraft and begins to hunt the human hosts.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam, and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death.”

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
programme.desc: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to have revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volume 2
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.

programme.title: Hollow Man
programme.desc: Kevin Bacon and Elisabeth Shue play former lovers who, along with a team of other scientists like themselves, discover the secret of invisibility.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe, or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: Widows
programme.desc: When four armed robbers are killed, their widows take fate into their own hands.

programme.title: Lila & Eve
programme.desc: Lila, a grief-stricken mother reeling from her son's murder, attends a support group where she meets Eve, who urges her to take matters into her own hands to track down her son's killers. They soon embark on a journey of revenge, but also recovery.

programme.title: Chasing the Dragon
programme.desc: Donnie Yen stars as infamous real-life drug kingpin Crippled Ho, who ruthlessly carved out his empire in 1960's Hong Kong.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: Shan (Donnie Yen) is a hardline cop with a long history of success, but his past comes back to haunt him when a sting is attacked by a group led by his former protégé (Nicholas Tse), a man set on destroying everyone who ever wronged him.

programme.title: Sakra
programme.desc: Starring & directed by international action star Donnie Yen—When a respected martial artist is accused of murder, he goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origin story and the unknown enemies working to destroy him.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Mr. Deeds
programme.desc: Funnyman Adam Sandler stars in MR. DEEDS, the hilarious remake of the classic American comedy Mr. Deeds Goes to Town.

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: Britt Reid is a slacker by day, party animal by night... until he finds a serious career that's seriously cool: crime-fighting action hero. As the Green Hornet, he teams up with gadget wiz and martial arts master Kato to take down LA's underworld.

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.

programme.title: Sense and Sensibility
programme.desc: Emma Thompson stars in the captivating romance based on Jane Austen's classic novel of two sisters' search for love in strict Victorian society.

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Johnny Depp is Ichabod Crane, an investigator determined to stop the murderous Headless Horseman.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Truman doesn’t realize that his quaint hometown is a giant studio set run by a visionary producer/director/creator (Ed Harris), that folks living and working there are Hollywood actors, and that even his incessantly bubbly wife is a contract player.

programme.title: Gridiron Gang
programme.desc: Sean Porter (Johnson) is a frustrated probation officer, as most of the kids he oversees end up back in prison or dead. Desperate to make a difference, he devises a plan to teach discipline and responsibility through football.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: The Last Victim
programme.desc: A Neo-Western thriller set in the American Southwest, following Sheriff Hickey as he tries to solve the worst case he has seen in his small town, likely committed by a violent local gang led by a fearsome criminal.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After a seemingly innocent sexual encounter, 19-year-old Jay becomes trapped by a vicious curse - "it" is following her, and the only way to save herself is to put others in harm's way.

programme.title: Jennifer's Body
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: A possessed cheerleader gains an appetite for her male classmates.

programme.title: Vampires of the Velvet Lounge
programme.desc: A coven of vampires hunts on dating apps, meeting vampire hunters and scheduling dates. The nights that unfold are action-packed, modern-horror madness.

programme.title: Cujo
programme.desc: While Donna and Vic Trenton struggle to save their rocky marriage, their son Tad befriends the loveable 200-lb St. Bernard who belongs to their mechanic.

programme.title: Children of the Corn
programme.desc: A young couple is trapped in a remote town where a dangerous religious cult of children believes that everyone over age 18 must be killed.

programme.title: Children Of The Corn II: The Final Sacrifice
programme.desc: The hit film inspired by the short-story by Stephen King spawns a sequel of rural shock and terror. This frightful follow-up has members of a nearby Nebraska town choosing to adopt the surviving adolescents from the previous pot-boiler.

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: High school senior, Ferris Bueller, decides to cut school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

programme.title: 48 Hrs.
programme.desc: Nolte is a rough-edged cop after two vicious cop-killers. He can't do it without the help of smooth Murphy, who is serving time for a half-million-dollar robbery.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop
programme.desc: The heat is on in this fast-paced action-comedy starring Eddie Murphy as Axel Foley, a street smart Detroit cop tracking down his best friend's killer in Beverly Hills.

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Young kids form a club that is devoted to monsters, but soon get more than they bargained for when Dracula adjourns to Earth, with Frankenstein's Monster, the Wolfman, the Mummy, and the Gillman.

programme.title: Popeye
programme.desc: The legendary, beloved anvil-armed sailor of the seven seas comes magically to life in this delightful musical, starring Robin Williams as Popeye, who meets all challenges with the unshakable philosophy, "I yam what I yam and that's all that I yam."

programme.title: Armored
programme.desc: A crew of officers at an armored transport security firm embarks on the ultimate heist – against their own company. The seemingly foolproof plan proves useless when an unexpected witness interferes, and it quickly unravels.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: A Hollywood stunt performer (Ryan Gosling) who moonlights as a wheelman discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.

programme.title: We Own the Night
programme.desc: What if your own family stood in the way of everything you worked for? Bobby Green (Joaquin Phoenix) has forsaken his name to escape his family and their tradition in law enforcement to pursue his ambitions as a Brooklyn nightclub owner. Rated R

programme.title: Pretty In Pink
programme.desc: She’s a high school girl from the wrong side of town. He’s the wealthy heartthrob who asks her to the prom. But as fast as their romance builds, it’s threatened by the painful reality of peer pressure.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: After a young, middle-class couple moves into what seems like a typical suburban house, they become increasingly disturbed by a presence that may or may not be demonic and active at night.

programme.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
programme.desc: Comedy sensation Mike Myers stars with Nancy Travis in this hatchet-driven romantic comedy about a wedlock-shy coffee house poet who finally meets the perfect woman. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
programme.desc: When the brilliant but unorthodox scientist Dr. Victor Frankenstein rejects the artificial man that he has created, the Creature escapes and later swears revenge.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: It's 2084 A.D., and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earth's closest planetary neighbor, Mars.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: The Return
programme.desc: The "Universal Soldiers" must fight the entire army when the military's supercomputer, S.E.T.H., gets out of control.

programme.title: The Longest Yard (1974)
programme.desc: In this rough-and tumble movie, actually filmed on-location at the Georgia State Prison, the cons are the heroes and the guards are the heavies.

programme.title: Saturday Night Fever
programme.desc: John Travolta performs as the troubled Tony Manero - Brooklyn paint store clerk by day and undisputed king of the dance floor by night. A powerful and provocative urban tragedy that carries as much significance today as it did in 1977.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Street Fighter (1994)
programme.desc: Based on the popular video game, this adventure stars martial arts star Jean-Claude Van Damme as a commando leading an elite team of street fighters against the forces of an evil general.

programme.title: Resident Evil
programme.desc: Unknown to the residents of Raccoon City, a huge underground bioengineering facility has accidentally unleashed the deadly T-virus. Now a team of highly-trained super commandos must race to isolate the T-virus before it overwhelms humanity.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: In this visionary film, Will and Jake Grimm dazzle small towns with their imaginative folklore and elaborate illusions, only to discover that many of the fantastic characters and thrilling situations from their beloved fairy tales are real.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: When flesh-eating zombies are on the hunt, it's up to slacker Shaun and his best pal to save their friends and family from becoming the next entrée.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Nicholas Angel is an unstoppable cop who, with the help of his bumbling partner, delivers some big-city justice in a small, quiet town.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
programme.desc: Fugitives Tris and Four search for allies and answers among the ruins of Chicago while arduously trying to evade Jeanine, leader of the Erudite.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
programme.desc: As a ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago to find a peaceful solution for their embroiled city.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: Molly Bloom runs the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested by the FBI. Her only ally is defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learns that there is much more to Molly than the tabloids lead people to believe.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: St. Vincent

programme.title: It! The Terror From Beyond Space

programme.title: House On Haunted Hill
programme.desc: A millionaire offers $10,000 to five people who agree to be locked in a large, spooky, rented house overnight with him and his wife.

programme.title: The Masque of the Red Death (1964)
programme.desc: When the sadistic prince (Vincent Price) finds that the Red Death has arrived in the village he rules, he forsakes his people and hides in his castle with his fellow aristocrats…until a mysterious stranger turns his haven into a danse macabre!

programme.title: The Pit and the Pendulum (1961)
programme.desc: Vincent Price slowly goes crazy because he thinks his wife was buried alive (a plot between his wife and her lover to get his money). Now totally insane, he starts to murder.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volume 2
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: The machete-wielding federale returns in this sequel, which pits him against a maniacal arms dealer and a revolutionary in a violent battle.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe, or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.

programme.title: Scream (2022)
programme.desc: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a terrifying new killer resurrects the Ghostface mask.

programme.title: Lila & Eve
programme.desc: Lila, a grief-stricken mother reeling from her son's murder, attends a support group where she meets Eve, who urges her to take matters into her own hands to track down her son's killers. They soon embark on a journey of revenge, but also recovery.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: A female flight attendant becomes a key figure in a plot between the police and an arms dealer.

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: Pam Grier stars as Coffy, a one-woman vigilante force, out to even the score with those who have hooked her sister on drugs. Coffy uses her sex appeal and an assortment of weapons to rid the streets of society's scum in this cult classic.

programme.title: Sakra
programme.desc: Starring & directed by international action star Donnie Yen—When a respected martial artist is accused of murder, he goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origin story and the unknown enemies working to destroy him.

programme.title: The Big Boss
programme.desc: Bruce Lee faces an underground criminal element after members of his family begin disappearing. Now he must break his vow of non-violence to take on the terrifying "Big Boss."

programme.title: Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Bruce Lee stars as Chen Zhen, a martial arts protégé who returns to his former school in Shanghai when he learns that his beloved instructor has been murdered. To avenge his master's death, Chen must fight the greatest assassins from a rival school.

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: Britt Reid is a slacker by day, party animal by night... until he finds a serious career that's seriously cool: crime-fighting action hero. As the Green Hornet, he teams up with gadget wiz and martial arts master Kato to take down LA's underworld.

programme.title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
programme.desc: Dewey Cox had it all: the women (over 411), the friends (Elvis), and the rock 'n' roll lifestyle (every pill and powder). But most of all, he had the music that transformed a dimwitted country boy into the greatest American rock star who never lived.

programme.title: Bruce Almighty
programme.desc: When a frustrated, downtrodden reporter curses the sky, God appears, endows him with divine powers, and challenges him to run the world for a week.

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: Only Lovers Left Alive
programme.desc: Driven by sensual photography, trance-like music, and droll humor, Jim Jarmusch’s ONLY LOVERS LEFT ALIVE is a meditation on art, science, and the mysteries of everlasting love.

programme.title: Elvis And Annabelle
programme.desc: Anabelle is a small town beauty on the road to being crowned the Miss Texas Rose title, when she tragically dies and on stage due to an eating disorder.

programme.title: Shutter Island

programme.title: Battle of Britain

programme.title: I Walk Alone
programme.desc: After taking the rap for his partner, a mobster is released from prison to find his former partner entranched in a swank night club with no intention of sharing the riches.

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: The machete-wielding federale returns in this sequel, which pits him against a maniacal arms dealer and a revolutionary in a violent battle.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Free Fire
programme.desc: When a black market arms deal goes outrageously wrong, Justine (Brie Larson) finds herself caught in the crossfire, forced to navigate a warehouse full of trigger-happy madmen all hanging on for dear life in this hilarious action-comedy.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.

programme.title: Scream (2022)
programme.desc: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a terrifying new killer resurrects the Ghostface mask.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: A female flight attendant becomes a key figure in a plot between the police and an arms dealer.

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: Pam Grier stars as Coffy, a one-woman vigilante force, out to even the score with those who have hooked her sister on drugs. Coffy uses her sex appeal and an assortment of weapons to rid the streets of society's scum in this cult classic.

programme.title: Foxy Brown
programme.desc: A blaxploitation film about a woman whose drug-dealing brother ratted on her undercover narcotics-agent boyfriend to the mob and she, in turn, poses as a call girl to infiltrate the mobsters who butchered him.

programme.title: The Big Boss
programme.desc: Bruce Lee faces an underground criminal element after members of his family begin disappearing. Now he must break his vow of non-violence to take on the terrifying "Big Boss."

programme.title: Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Bruce Lee stars as Chen Zhen, a martial arts protégé who returns to his former school in Shanghai when he learns that his beloved instructor has been murdered. To avenge his master's death, Chen must fight the greatest assassins from a rival school.

programme.title: A Game of Death
programme.desc: Billy Lo, a champion fighter and movie star, fakes his death to escape and then expose the crime syndicate that wants to control him.

programme.title: Bruce Almighty
programme.desc: When a frustrated, downtrodden reporter curses the sky, God appears, endows him with divine powers, and challenges him to run the world for a week.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Caddyshack
programme.desc: It's the snobs against the slobs! While caddy Danny tries to impress elitist Judge Smails, a crude construction tycoon tries to get accepted at the country club, and a groundskeeper stalks a gopher.

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: Only Lovers Left Alive
programme.desc: Driven by sensual photography, trance-like music, and droll humor, Jim Jarmusch’s ONLY LOVERS LEFT ALIVE is a meditation on art, science, and the mysteries of everlasting love.

programme.title: Elvis And Annabelle
programme.desc: Anabelle is a small town beauty on the road to being crowned the Miss Texas Rose title, when she tragically dies and on stage due to an eating disorder.

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Johnny Depp is Ichabod Crane, an investigator determined to stop the murderous Headless Horseman.

programme.title: And Soon The Darkness (2010)
programme.desc: When two American girls (Amber Heard of ZOMBIELAND, Odette Yustman of CLOVERFIELD) on a bike trip in a remote part of Argentina split up and one of them goes missing, the other must find her before darkness falls.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: Mona Lisa Smile
programme.desc: Julia Roberts stars as a novice art history professor with a surprising lesson plan that inspires her students to open their eyes to love and life.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Based on the true story of four outsiders who saw what the big banks, media, and government refused to: the global collapse of the economy. A bold investment leads them into the dark underbelly of banking, where everyone and everything is in question.

programme.title: Forsaken (2014)
programme.desc: In 1872, an embittered gunslinger named John Henry Clayton attempts to make amends with his estranged father, Reverend Samuel Clayton, while their community is besieged by ruthless land-grabbers.

programme.title: Bull
programme.desc: Kris is forced to help her neighbor, an ex-bull rider scraping by on the Texas rodeo circuit.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Vampires of the Velvet Lounge
programme.desc: A coven of vampires hunts on dating apps, meeting vampire hunters and scheduling dates. The nights that unfold are action-packed, modern-horror madness.

programme.title: Little Nicky
programme.desc: When Satan reneges on his plans to retire, two of his three heirs leave Hell to gather enough souls to vote the Prince of Darkness out of office. But Satan sends his youngest—and nicest—son, Little Nicky, to bring the other two home.

programme.title: Billy Madison
programme.desc: 27-year-old Billy Madison must repeat all 12 grades of school to earn his father's respect and prove he has what it takes to run the family business.

programme.title: Children Of The Corn: The Gathering
programme.desc: Somewhere out in the cornfields lurks an unspeakable evil, and a bright young medical student is determined to solve the mystery behind the sinister plague in this fourth chilling chapter of a movie series inspired by Stephen King's short-story.

programme.title: Children Of The Corn V: Fields Of Terror
programme.desc: Six college students take a very wrong turn, and find themselves lost in a strangely deserted rural town ruled by a murderous cult of children controlled by evil forces in the fifth chapter of the popular horror movie franchise.

programme.title: Children Of The Corn 666: Isaac's Return
programme.desc: 19 years ago a child led a cult of kids to murder and fulfill a sinister prophecy. Now Isaac is back, and the strange rituals have returned in this sixth installment of one of the most popular horror movie franchises of all time.

programme.title: Trading Places
programme.desc: The story of a down-and-out con artist who trades lifestyles with a well-to-do investor.

programme.title: 48 Hrs.
programme.desc: Nolte is a rough-edged cop after two vicious cop-killers. He can't do it without the help of smooth Murphy, who is serving time for a half-million-dollar robbery.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: D.A.R.Y.L.
programme.desc: A young boy is found wandering, with no memory of who he is. A family takes him in and begins to look for clues to help him find his way home.

programme.title: A.I. Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: In a future world, humans share aspects of their lives with companion robots called Mechas. But when an advanced prototype robot child named David is programmed to show unconditional love, his human family isn't prepared for the consequences.

programme.title: The Time Machine
programme.desc: Hoping to alter the events of the past, a 19th-century inventor instead travels 800,000 years into the future, where he finds humankind divided into two warring races.

programme.title: Thunderheart
programme.desc: Val Kilmer, Sam Shepard, and Graham Greene star in this murder mystery filled with style and suspense. Kilmer stars as Ray Levoi, a hotshot FBI agent who's thrust into a strange new world when he is sent to solve a murder on an Indian reservation.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Burning
programme.desc: Hailed by critics as one of the best films of the year, BURNING is a searing romantic thriller about a young man whose suspicions spin out of control when the free-spirited woman he loves disappears.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz of KICK-ASS), a beautiful but peculiar girl who turns out to be a vampire.

programme.title: Only Lovers Left Alive
programme.desc: Driven by sensual photography, trance-like music, and droll humor, Jim Jarmusch’s ONLY LOVERS LEFT ALIVE is a meditation on art, science, and the mysteries of everlasting love.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: It's 2084 A.D., and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earth's closest planetary neighbor, Mars.

programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: 2029 – A female government cyber agent and the Internal Bureau of Investigations are hot on the trail of a "The Puppet Master" – a computer virus capable of invading cybernetic brains and altering its victim’s memory.

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: "Supernova" chronicles the search and rescue patrol of a deep space medical ship and its six-member crew.

programme.title: Semi-Tough
programme.desc: Barbara Jane (Jill Clayburgh), Billy Clyde (Burt Reynolds) and Shake (Kris Kristofferson) have been best friends for years. But when Barbara Jane's new interest in Shake turns into love, Billy Clyde realizes she's the woman he’s wanted all along!

programme.title: The Longest Yard (1974)
programme.desc: In this rough-and tumble movie, actually filmed on-location at the Georgia State Prison, the cons are the heroes and the guards are the heavies.

programme.title: White Lightning
programme.desc: In one of his most memorable roles, Burt Reynolds portrays a moonshine whiskey runner who turns state's witness to avenge the murder of a boy no one understood.

programme.title: Street Fighter (1994)
programme.desc: Based on the popular video game, this adventure stars martial arts star Jean-Claude Van Damme as a commando leading an elite team of street fighters against the forces of an evil general.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic from spreading worldwide.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: In this visionary film, Will and Jake Grimm dazzle small towns with their imaginative folklore and elaborate illusions, only to discover that many of the fantastic characters and thrilling situations from their beloved fairy tales are real.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady thinks she understands "survival of the fittest." However, the law of the wild takes on a whole new meaning when the homeschooled 15-year-old enters public high school for the first time.

programme.title: The Mexican

programme.desc: Il passato della neomamma Roseanne continua a tormentarla, creando scompiglio nella vita della sua famiglia, mentre una ferita alla schiena costringe Violet ad affidare il suo negozio a Fred, con conseguenze impreviste.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 5, Episodio 6
programme.desc: Una serie di violenti attacchi alle donne getta nel terrore Poplar e ha un impatto diretto sui residenti di Nonnatus House.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 5, Episodio 7
programme.desc: Il dottor Turner si prepara al cambiamento con l'introduzione della pillola contraccettiva, mentre Patsy cerca di aiutare una donna che vive su una chiatta ed è decisa a partorire nella sua comunità.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ritiro totale
programme.desc: Dopo essere stato gravemente ferito in un'esplosione in laboratorio, Dylan viaggia attraverso una serie di realtà alternative.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delirio da trattato quantico
programme.desc: Rommie viene ricostruita per aiutare a evacuare il sistema Seefra.

programme.title: Andromeda: La luce di un nuovo giorno
programme.desc: Un capo militare convince i suoi seguaci che l'imminente distruzione dei pianeti esterni è un complotto per saccheggiare il loro pianeta.

programme.title: Andromeda: Il caos e la sua calma
programme.desc: Dylan, Rhade e Beka uniscono le forze per salvare Trance da Methus-2 e Harper dal Generale Burma.

programme.title: Andromeda: Il cuore del viaggio (Parte 1)
programme.desc: L'equipaggio lascia finalmente il sistema Seefra e scopre che Dylan è l'ultimo Paradine.

programme.title: Andromeda: Il cuore del viaggio (Parte 2)
programme.desc: Nell’ultimo episodio della serie, la battaglia finale per salvare il Nuovo Commonwealth del Sistema ha inizio.

programme.title: Bancopaz
programme.desc: Alla Desert Savings Bank tutti sognano il colpo perfetto, ma nessuno sa che anche gli altri lo stanno pianificando. Sheila, Stuart e Jason si ritrovano nella stessa notte a svaligiare la banca, scatenando un'improbabile e caotica resa dei conti.

programme.title: Made in America
programme.desc: Quando la figlia apprende la verità in merito, 18 anni dopo, e cerca di capire chi sia il padre anonimo, scopre che si tratta di un venditore di auto bianco.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Belly
programme.desc: Lilly, di origini inglesi, fugge dall'Etiopia per raggiungere l'Inghilterra durante la guerra civile, e, nel complesso in cui vive, inizia una missione per riunire le famiglie disperse e ritrovare Aziz, il suo amato scomparso in circostanze misteriose.

programme.title: Lo Straniero della valle oscura
programme.desc: Un western europeo con Sam Riley, Tobias Moretti e Paula Beer. Sul finire del XIX secolo, uno straniero di nome Greider arriva in un villaggio alpino per l’inverno. Gli abitanti ignorano che lui conosca il segreto che custodiscono da decenni.

programme.title: Il testamento di Madigan
programme.desc: Il giovane Frank Putzu diventa un funzionario del Dipartimento del Tesoro statunitense. Apparentemente ingenuo e mite, viene inviato a Roma per recuperare una grossa somma di denaro dovuto al governo degli Stati Uniti da Mike Madigan, un mafioso morto.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: Un confuso uomo esce da una fontana del parco in Vietnam senza ricordare chi sia o da dove venga. Mentre vaga per la città, mettendo insieme indizi sul suo passato, viene inseguito senza sosta da figure misteriosamente pericolose.

programme.title: A Wedding Wonderland
programme.desc: L’amore viene messo alla prova quando i preparativi del matrimonio vanno storti e lo stress di accontentare le famiglie della coppia diventa insostenibile.

programme.title: Un matrimonio su misura
programme.desc: Cassie, contabile e perfezionista, crede che la sua vita sia perfettamente sulla buona strada, almeno fino a quella di sua madre la wedding planner abbandona e torna nella sua città natale per organizzare l'evento.

programme.title: Amnesia d'amore
programme.desc: Insoddisfatta del suo matrimonio, Caroline ha deciso di divorziare ma la perdita della memoria in seguito a un incidente le farà ritrovare l'armonia con il marito.

programme.title: La casa dei sogni
programme.desc: Una coppia cerca la casa perfetta in cui andare a vivere e decide di assumere un architetto. L'uomo, invece di svolgere il lavoro per il quale era stato assunto, progetta la dimora dei propri sogni.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: A Parigi, Grace e le sue amiche sono in un albergo di lusso, quando una di loro viene scambiata per una ricca ereditiera. Neanche il tempo di chiarire, che già sono verso Monte Carlo…

programme.title: La storia infinita
programme.desc: Un ragazzino di 10 anni, prende un libro intitolato La storia infinita in una vecchia libreria, e inizia a sfogliarlo. Legge la storia di Fantasia, una terra magica governata dall'Imperatrice Bambina e abitata da tutti i tipi di creature meravigliose.

programme.title: A prova d'inganno
programme.desc: Amanda, laureata in ingegneria aeronautica, sta lavorando a un grande progetto ma un collega se ne appropria e lo spaccia per suo. Quando l'uomo viene assassinato, la ragazza diventa la principale sospettata.

programme.title: Signori, il delitto è servito
programme.desc: Incontrate tutti i famosi sospetti e scoprite tutte le loro armi del delitto. Amerete le loro azioni ignobili come i corpi e le risate che si accumuleranno davanti ai vostri occhi.

programme.title: An Acceptable Loss - Decisione Estrema
programme.desc: Elizabeth Lamm insegna all’università e possiede degli scritti sugli eventi di sicurezza nazionale che l’hanno vista coinvolta quando lavorava al Pentagono; la vicepresidente americana le aveva dato ordini indicibili che la tormentano tutt'ora.

programme.title: Strade perdute
programme.desc: All'ingresso della propria casa lussuosa e asettica, Fred Madison scopre alcune videocassette che ritraggono lui e la moglie mentre dormono. L'ultimo video ricevuto li riprende mentre lui è intento a massacrare lei, ma purtroppo Fred non ricorda nulla.

programme.title: Vacanze sulla neve
programme.desc: Durante una settimana bianca si intrecciano le vicende e i flirt di alcuni giovani vacanzieri ospiti dello stesso hotel.

programme.title: Un sindaco fuori dal comune
programme.desc: Rocco, un pastore di un paese di 18.000 anime chiamato Poggiostorto, decide di candidarsi alle prossime elezioni comunali. Inizia la campagna elettorale, e Rocco, supportato dai suoi amici, intraprende un percorso che lo porterà alla vittoria.

programme.title: Cristian e Palletta contro tutti
programme.desc: Cristian è convinto che nella vita l'unica via per il successo sia la botta di fortuna. Quando gli viene proposto di trafugare della cocaina, Cristian vede nell'impresa la svolta! Decide così di coinvolgere il suo storico compagno di oziosità, Palletta.

programme.title: Nove cuccioli sotto l'albero
programme.desc: Two humans. Eleven cats. It’s chaos this Christmas in the picturesque small town of Jamesville, where an unlikely couple discover there’s not a more ‘purrfect’ time for the important things in life: family, love – and perhaps a romantic engagement!

programme.title: Un Natale indimenticabile
programme.desc: If Princess Colette were to get a Christmas wish, she would rather be a fashion designer than heir to her country’s throne, but when she works for rising designer Wilson James on a charity Christmas Eve Gala, she finds both her true love.

programme.title: Le scarpe magiche di Natale
programme.desc: Noelle, che detesta il Natale, resta bloccata in un grande magazzino alla Vigilia. Qui incontra una donna che sostiene di essere il suo angelo custode e le fa vivere una esperienza simile a quella raccontata da 'Canto di natale' di Charles Dickens.

programme.title: Come salvare il Natale
programme.desc: Megan usa le settimane che precedono ogni Natale per aiutare gli altri. Chiamata a salvare la festa di Natale della sua cittadina, la ragazza si ritrova contesa tra l'uomo dei suoi sogni e il partner ideale.

programme.title: Il regno di Wuba
programme.desc: La regina dei mostri, che è incinta, prima di morire affida al giovane Tianyin il suo piccolo, destinato a diventare il nuovo re della sua specie. Così, Tianyin dovrà proteggerlo dai cacciatori di mostri che cercano di catturarlo.

programme.title: La ragazza dei miei sogni
programme.desc: P. è un trentenne insoddisfatto, condizionato da molte situazioni che gli impediscono di vivere come vorrebbe.

programme.title: 2 lava 2 lantula
programme.desc: Secondo adrenalinico capitolo della saga spin-off di Sharknado. Quando un'eruzione vulcanica risveglia una colonia di ragni che invade e terrorizza la Florida, l'attore Colton West abbandona il set per correre in soccorso della figlia.

programme.title: Alien Abduction - Rapimenti Alieni
programme.desc: La famiglia Morris si trova in vacanza sulle Brown Mountain in North Carolina per vivere un’esperienza a stretto contatto con la natura.

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Giant Octopus
programme.desc: Nelle profondità del mare stanno succedendo degli eventi strani. La biologa marina Emma MacNeil viene inviata a indagare. Un enorme squalo preistorico e un polpo gigante sono stati risvegliati dal loro gelido sonno e hanno fame.

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Mecha Shark
programme.desc: Quando un nuovo Mega Squalo minaccia l'umanità, il governo scatena l'arma top secret Mecha Shark per sconfiggere il mostro in una battaglia campale che minaccia il pianeta.

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Crocosaurus
programme.desc: Un enorme squalo preistorico è sopravvissuto all'ultima battaglia e il mondo è ancora minacciato quando un nuovo nemico più pericoloso viene scoperto nelle giungle dell'Africa.

programme.title: Ringo, il volto della vendetta
programme.desc: Banditi, coloni, un baro e uno sceriffo si mettono in caccia di un favoloso tesoro. Il tesoro viene trovato dal solito eroe silenzioso e solitario, ma ci sono voluti molti morti.

programme.title: Se incontri Sartana prega per la tua morte
programme.desc: Bande rivali si scontrano intorno ad una cassa d'oro rubata ad una diligenza. L'unico che la spunta è Sartana, sopravvissuto ad un agguato grazie ad una placca di rame antiproiettile. Per vendicarsi, farà una strage.

programme.title: Alleluja e Sartana figli di... Dio
programme.desc: Alleluja e Sartana rubano alcuni cavalli di proprietà di un delinquente soprannominato Lupo. I suoi uomini li inseguono, il secondo viene catturato ma il primo riesce a salvarlo.

programme.title: Killer Calibro 32
programme.desc: Un temibile killer accetta l'incarico di trovare la banda di rapinatori che durante l'ultima impresa hanno ucciso tutti i viaggiatori di una diligenza.

programme.title: Hornet
programme.desc: Una razza aliena, intenta a decimare l'umanità e a ripopolare la Terra, fa il lavaggio del cervello agli umani per compiere atti di distruzione. L'unica speranza dell'umanità risiede in un robot hi-tech non testato.

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Mecha Shark
programme.desc: Quando un nuovo Mega Squalo minaccia l'umanità, il governo scatena l'arma top secret Mecha Shark per sconfiggere il mostro in una battaglia campale che minaccia il pianeta.

programme.title: Ape vs Monster
programme.desc: Una scimmia, persa nello spazio, si schianta sulla Terra. Il vascello trasuda un fango che innesca una crescita massiccia sia nella scimmia che in una lucertola di passaggio.

programme.title: Hornet
programme.desc: Una razza aliena, intenta a decimare l'umanità e a ripopolare la Terra, fa il lavaggio del cervello agli umani per compiere atti di distruzione. L'unica speranza dell'umanità risiede in un robot hi-tech non testato.

programme.title: Renegade: Il fantasma
programme.desc: Reno viene ferito dal criminale che stava inseguendo e rischia di morire, salvandosi grazie all'arrivo dell'ambulanza; Bobby e Sandy lo aiutano poi a fuggire dall'ospedale, prima che Dixon lo trovi.

programme.title: Renegade: Cercasi disperatamente Molly
programme.desc: Una bambina di nome Molly va da Sandy dicendo che è stata rapita e mostra una confezione di latte con la sua foto e la scritta "scomparsa"; si scopre che Molly vive coi suoi genitori, suo padre è un testimone protetto e deve continuamente trasferirsi.

programme.title: Renegade: Casinò
programme.desc: Una banda di motociclisti deruba i vincitori di un casinò, il padrone del locale chiama Bobby in aiuto e lo assume in incognito. Intanto, Reno trova la banda in un paese vicino ma il capo lo riconosce e lo obbliga a partecipare al furto successivo.

programme.title: Renegade: Spie
programme.desc: Melissa, la moglie di Dixon, è intenzionata a far condannare il marito e chiede aiuto a Reno e Bobby. Reno accetta: la donna difatti non finge, è rimasta disgustata dal fatto che Dixon è ora complice di un giro di pornografia minorile.

programme.title: Renegade: Nuova identità
programme.desc: Imbattendosi in un uomo creduto morto, Bobby scopre che una banda offre la possibilità ai ricercati di fingere la propria morte. Intanto, Bobby viene raggiunto da una collega di cui si innamora.

programme.title: Renegade: Il dinamitardo
programme.desc: Un rapinatore ha colpito varie banche fingendo di avere, un maldestro informatore di Bobby cerca di arrestarlo, finendo lui stesso catturato dal ladro. L'uomo convince il rapinatore che Bobby pagherà una grossa somma per riaverlo vivo.

programme.title: Un Divorzio Pericoloso
programme.desc: Quando l'ex marito di Josie, Michael, le fa un'offerta di lavoro che non può rifiutare, si trova in mezzo ad un brutale divorzio tra Michael e la sua pazza ex moglie Cora.

programme.title: Veglio su di voi
programme.desc: Sarah, mamma single, si trasferisce in periferia e inizia a frequentare un pompiere, solo per ritrovarsi il bersaglio di un ossessivo vicino che mira a dimostrare di essere l'uomo migliore per proteggerla... anche se deve creare lui stesso il pericolo.

programme.title: La Mia Nemica Chloe
programme.desc: Samantha e la figlia Blake invitano Chloe nella loro casa in California. Le due ragazze diventano amiche. Con la morte sospetta del fidanzato di Blake Samantha scopre il piano di Chloe. Quello di "adottare" Samantha come sua "mamma".

programme.title: La banda degli onesti
programme.desc: Tre uomini perbene ma goffi che affrontano difficoltà economiche iniziano con riluttanza a fabbricare banconote false. Il figlio di uno di loro è il poliziotto che segue il caso, ignorando il coinvolgimento del padre.

programme.title: Uccellacci E Uccellini
programme.desc: Totò e Ninetto, vagabondano nella periferia romana per minacciare di sfratto una famiglia che non paga l'affitto. Nel tragitto li segue un corvo parlante, intellettuale e marxista, che racconta le vicende dei frati francescani Ciccillo e Ninetto.

programme.title: Totò, Peppino e le fanatiche
programme.desc: Finiti ingiustamente in manicomio, il ragionier Vignanelli e il cavalier Caprioli raccontano al direttore le folli fissazioni e le manie dei rispettivi familiari. Convinto dalla loro storia, il medico li dimette per ricoverare i veri matti: le famiglie.

programme.desc: Gli Immortali è il canale dedicato ai giganti del cinema d'azione: un vero e proprio campo di battaglia dove le più grandi star del genere si scontrano attraverso i loro film più iconici.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Post mortem
programme.desc: Durante l'esplorazione di alcuni asteroidi, l'equipaggio della Voyager trova il luogo di sepoltura di una specie aliena. Durante l'esame dei corpi, Kim viene intrappolato in una frattura subspaziale che lo porta sul pianeta principale della specie.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Fattori primi
programme.desc: Dopo essere venuta a contatto con l'amichevole specie dei Sikariani, la Voyager scopre che essi possiedono una tecnologia simile al teletrasporto che gli permette di compiere viaggi di oltre 40000 anni luce.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Radimento a Bordo
programme.desc: La Voyager risponde al segnale di soccorso di una nave Kazon, scoprendo successivamente che l'equipaggio è morto a causa di radiazioni provenienti da un uso errato della tecnologia dei replicatori in uso alla Flotta Stellare.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Eroi e demoni -
programme.desc: Harry Kim scompare all'interno del suo programma olografico basato su Beowulf, e così accade a Tuvok e Chakotay, entrati nel programma per cercarlo. Il Dottore viene quindi inviato per recuperarli, sperando che il suo essere un ologramma possa aiutarlo.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Intruso a bordo
programme.desc: Chakotay rimane gravemente ferito durante una missione nei pressi di una nebulosa, e viene dichiarato cerebralmente morto. Ad ogni tentativo di allontanarsi, tuttavia, un'entità aliena cerca di riportarli indietro.

programme.title: Mission Impossible: L'amnesia
programme.desc: Nei panni di un medico con una nuova sorprendente cura per l'amnesia, Jim Phelps costringe Paris a rivivere il passato di un altro uomo quando l'IMF si mette alla ricerca di materiale nucleare rubato.

programme.title: Mission Impossible: Chico
programme.desc: Un collezionista di francobolli rari, su ordine dell'Impossible Mission Force, intraprende un viaggio pericoloso verso la roccaforte di un boss della narcotici.

programme.title: Mission Impossible: I fantasmi
programme.desc: Per combattere l'epurazione dei giovani artisti da parte di un vecchio dittatore, un membro dellIMF diventa un fantasma e Paris assume le sembianze di un uomo morto da tempo.

programme.title: Mission Impossible: Terrore
programme.desc: Per calmare una zona problematica in Medio Oriente, l'IMF cerca di tenere un uomo in prigione abbastanza a lungo da far sembrare che stia cercando di evadere.

programme.title: Mission Impossible: La squadra della morte
programme.desc: Jim Phelps guida l'IMF per aiutare uno dei suoi stessi membri quando Barney viene arrestato e condannato a morte da un sadico capo della polizia.

programme.title: L'arte di arrangiarsi
programme.desc: Rosario Scimoni ha vent'anni e vive a Catania all'inizio del XX secolo. Ama due cose nella vita: le donne e il denaro ed è il segretario del sindaco che è suo zio e l'amante della moglie del sindaco.

programme.title: Il respiro del bosco
programme.desc: Il documentario rivela il fantastico mondo nascosto dei funghi e delle muffe, veri alleati della natura. Un’avventura tra misteri, pericoli e meraviglie, che ci invita a rispettare e amare i nostri tesori silenziosi.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Ritiro Aziendale
programme.desc: È la giornata annuale del ritiro aziendale a Mad Style, e il signor Madigan pensa, anziché fare un viaggio come al solito, di portare un luogo esotico all'interno dell'azienda.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Ballo Dell'ultimo Minuto
programme.desc: True riceve due biglietti per un ballo, e non sa chi dei suoi due amici portare con se', Lulu o Ryan. Ma anche Billy ha due biglietti e dice di voler invitare una ragazza che lavora alla Mad Style.

programme.title: True Jackson: La Spia
programme.desc: Max è appena tornato da un viaggio in Africa e ha portato con sé una nuova scoperta segreta: un tessuto eco compatibile ricavato dalla corteccia dell'albero Matuba.

programme.title: True Jackson: Amanda Assume Una Pink
programme.desc: Alla Mad Style si presentano le Pink, tre ragazze terribili che frequentano la stessa scuola di True. La ragazza è terrorizzata soprattutto da una di loro, Pinky e quando Amanda lo scopre, la assume.

programme.title: True Jackson: La Settimana Della Moda
programme.desc: È la "settimana della moda", uno dei più grandi eventi dell'anno a New York, e, con sorpresa di tutti, questa volta Mad Style è stata scartata dalle selezioni.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Manichino Di Max
programme.desc: La Mad Style deve presentare la nuova linea maschile per l'autunno e Max è alla ricerca di un'idea per promuovere il lancio.

programme.title: True Jackson: Scambio Di Ruoli
programme.desc: True lancia l'idea di organizzare uno "scambio-day" perché tutti comprendano il lavoro dei colleghi all'interno della Mad Style. Il destino le affida il ruolo di grande capo.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Matrimonio
programme.desc: È una data storica a Mad Style: è il giorno del matrimonio tra Doris e Max. Le attività ordinarie della casa di moda vengono sospese e tutti si dedicano ai preparativi per il grande evento.

programme.title: True Jackson: Tutti A Casa Di Mikey J
programme.desc: True ha un'importante presentazione da organizzare ma Ryan e Lulu ci tengono a ricordarle che ha promesso di partecipare alla festa di Mikey J, il fidanzatino dell'amica.
